scenario: LUNI.13.11: the function `round(x)` (LEXP.3.2) is not a currency construct, so it compiles while finance is deferred. The positive half of LUNI.13.11_round_method: a refusal keyed on the name `round` alone, rather than on the method form, turns this vector red. PATH PINNED: the same compiler refusal, on its admitting side.
